.subckt pmos_bias_generator ib_sink vdd

children.role_hint: Main single-ended complementary-input OTA core; vin and vip drive matched NMOS/PMOS input devices, vo is the amplified single-ended output, and ib_sink biases the PMOS tail current source
children.role_description: Main single-ended complementary-input OTA core; vin and vip drive matched NMOS/PMOS input devices, vo is the amplified single-ended output, and ib_sink biases the PMOS tail current source
children.netlist:
.subckt complementary_input_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
M4 vo vin net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
.ends complementary_input_ota_core
